A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator, rewriting a whole number with a fractional part, or normalizing a mixed number whose fractional part is improper.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to match a fractional denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the numbers are already in directly compatible form and no rewriting or denominator alignment is performed.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction after forms are already aligned.
Do not tag for simplification of the final answer after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed-number expressions once the forms are compatible.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when the subtraction produces zero or a negative fractional intermediate before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding an LCD or rewriting numbers into compatible forms.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping from the whole part to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag for reducing the final fraction or combining parts into final notation.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into n/n or equivalent fractional units and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial negative fractional difference or anticipated fractional shortfall.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for merely rewriting a whole number as x + 0/n before any need to borrow.
Do not tag for final simplification or combining the answer.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or integer by combining whole and fractional parts when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines a whole-number part and a fractional part into a mixed number.
Tag when the solution states the final result in integer form because the fractional part is zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or rewriting inputs before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator and/or rewriting a whole number as a mixed/fractional form with denominator 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d so fraction parts can be subtracted.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are explicitly rewritten to a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting to a common denominator or 0/d form occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper fraction part inside a mixed number; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the actual subtraction step after forms are already aligned.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with a nonproper fractional part or an unsimplified fractional part into a standard equivalent mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten as a standard mixed number.
Tag when the fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction, such as 4/10 to 2/5.
Tag when the normalization is done specifically to make later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction valid.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary simplification of the final answer after subtraction; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as x + 0/d; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S03.

skills.name: Subtract with regrouping
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction of fractions or mixed numbers, including borrowing/regrouping from the whole part when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for like-denominator fractions.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the solution borrows 1 whole and converts it to d/d to complete the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory conversion to common denominators or 0/d form; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of malformed mixed numbers before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination alone when no subtraction/regrouping is being performed.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and express it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction result is simplified, such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
Tag when the final answer is expressed after recognizing that the whole part is 0 or the fractional part is 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computation itself; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag conversion to common denominators or rewriting forms before subtraction; that belongs to S01 or S02.
Do not tag intermediate equivalent-fraction rewrites that are not the final simplified expression.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional quantities into compatible forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator and/or converting an equivalent fraction representation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator and rewrites one or both fractions accordingly.
Tag when the solution simplifies or rewrites a fractional part to an equivalent form so the subtraction can proceed directly.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten with a fractional part such as 0/denominator to align parts for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag for merely combining final whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard equivalent mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when the solution explicitly states that a mixed number is normalized because its fraction part is improper.
Tag when this normalization is done before any subtraction of whole or fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding common denominators or simplifying ordinary fractions.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
Do not tag for borrowing 1 from the whole part during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole-number parts and fractional parts separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the solution performs the main subtraction after any needed rewriting or normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for preparatory rewriting such as finding an LCD, simplifying an equivalent fraction, or normalizing an improper mixed number.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping itself; that belongs to a separate skill.
Do not tag for final simplification of the result to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Resolve a negative fractional part by borrowing from the whole part when needed and express the final answer in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part to turn a negative or insufficient fractional part into an equivalent positive fraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a resulting fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines the adjusted whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer after regrouping/simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the initial subtraction before any regrouping is needed.
Do not tag for merely finding a common denominator or rewriting equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Do not tag when the solution ends immediately after straightforward subtraction with no simplification beyond already-lowest terms.
